name: Electric Vehicle Systems
description: This course covers the following in electric vehicles: history and evolution of EVs, benefits of EVs compared to conventional transportation systems, study of different kinds of forces that act on a typical electric vehicle. Study and design of different components/subsystems of a typical EV such as electric motor, drivetrain, powertrain, battery, charging etc., for different type of driving cycle and range.
